newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-TEAMS IN EUROPEAN SUPER CUP FINAL, SECOND LEG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS IN EUROPEAN SUPER CUP FINAL, SECOND LEG.

text.p: Teams in Wednesday's final, second leg of the European Super Cup between Juventus of Italy and Paris St Germain of France:

Juventus: 1-Angelo Peruzzi, 3-Moreno Torricelli, 2-Ciro Ferrara, 4-Paolo Montero, 22-Gianluca Pessotto, 7-Angelo Di Livio, 20-Alessio Tacchinardi, 21-Zinedine Zidane, 18-Vladimir Jugovic, 10-Alessandro Del Piero, 11-Michele Padovano.
PSG: 1-Bernard Lama, 17-Jimmy Algerino, 22-Didier Domi, 6-Paul Le Guen, 2-Daniel Kenedy, 10-Rai, 8-Vincent Guerin, 15-Benoit Cauet, 7-Leonardo, 11-Patrice Loko, 8-Dely Valdes.
